reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text:
★☆☆☆☆

I would not recommend this company based on my experience. I purchased a 6-month subscription and only used the service for a couple of months. When my subscription automatically renewed, I contacted customer service on the very first day to request a refund since I no longer needed the service.

I was told that because the renewal was prepaid, I could not cancel or receive a refund for the next six months. This policy is extremely unfair and feels like the company is forcing customers to pay for a service they no longer want or use.

A company that truly values its customers should have a reasonable cancellation and refund policy, especially when a customer contacts them immediately after an automatic renewal. Instead, I was left feeling trapped and ignored.

The app itself may work for some people, but the company’s billing practices and lack of customer-friendly support have left me with a very negative impression. I will not be using their services again and cannot recommend them to others.
